questions.question: Why is it important for a counsellor to study the individual?
questions.solution_html:
• Importance of studying the individual
  • To understand their needs, behaviour, personality, and problems for effective counselling.
  • (any two importance - (1 mark) each)
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: State two differences between diary and daily schedule
questions.solution_html:
• Differences between diary and daily schedule
  • Diary: Personal record of events and reflections ((1mark))
  • Daily Schedule: Planned list of activities/time table. ((1mark))
questions.final_answer: Daily Schedule: Planned list of activities/time table. ()
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Mention any two things to be noted while observing a therapy session.
questions.solution_html:
• Things to note while observing a therapy session
  • Counsellor–client interaction. ((1mark))
  • Client’s verbal and non-verbal cues. ((1mark))
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Write two limitations of personality assessment techniques
questions.solution_html:
• Limitations of personality assessment techniques

  • Advice-giving offers direct suggestions. ((1 mark))

questions.question: Analyse the role of modelling in behaviour modification with examples.
questions.solution_html:
• Role of modelling in behaviour modification
  • Learning by observing others’ behaviour and outcomes. ((3 marks))
  • Includes live, symbolic, and participant modelling. ((3 marks))
  • Used in social skill training and phobia treatment. ((4 marks))
questions.final_answer: Used in social skill training and phobia treatment. ()
